subject: Embark x Redwood: LangSync adaptor pilot + security checklist
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@embark.ai>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: Jurgen Meier <jurgen@langsync.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Embark idea — LangSync adaptor pilot with Redwood

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the intro at the meetup last week — Jurgen and I chatted afterwards and we think a lightweight adaptor that lets LangSync callers route to Redwood for hosted inference would be a great win for our users.

High level ask: a 4-week pilot to validate latency/cost for a real-ish workload (customer support summarization, ~1k tokens/session, 50 concurrent sessions). We'd like to scope a short SOW, security checklist, and a staging demo before committing.

Attachments: Embark_prod_sample_payloads.json (sample), proposed-pilot-outline.md

Would you be open to a quick kickoff this week? Happy to take whatever time fits your calendar.

—Elena
Director, Integrations | Embark.ai
From: mateo_alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@embark.ai>, Jurgen Meier <jurgen@langsync.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Embark idea — LangSync adaptor pilot with Redwood

Elena — thanks for the clear brief. Very interested.

Brief reply to confirm next steps from Redwood side:
1) Pilot SOW draft + milestones (I can share a one-page next-day).
2) Security/basic compliance checklist (I'll kick off with SOOJIN and Security).
3) Quick staging demo — suggest Thu 10/23 or Mon 10/26, 30m.

Vanessa — looping you for commercial guardrails (pricing/credits) and to see if we want a minimal commit or a no-commit pilot.

Action: Elena, can you share the sample traffic profile (qps, token distribution) and any IP allowlist/CORS constraints? I'll circulate the SOW skeleton once I sync with Soojin on the checklist.

Thanks,
Mateo
Sr. Partner Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Elena Torres <elena@embark.ai>
Cc: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Embark idea — LangSync adaptor pilot with Redwood

Appreciate the intro and context. Quick commercial notes:
- We can offer a 6-week pilot package (covers infra credits + dedicated pilot monitoring) at a joint cost model; if Embark wants to cover 25% of cloud spend we can commit credits to offset the rest.
- I'll send a short MSA addendum and a draft SOW (one-pager) after we agree scope.

Sooj
@Sooj — can you own the security checklist? Key asks from Embark will likely be: SOC 2 evidence, data isolation boundaries, ingress/egress, and telemetry retention.

Vanessa Ortiz
Partnerships Lead | Redwood Inference
From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, mateo_alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Elena Torres <elena@embark.ai>
Cc: Jurgen Meier <jurgen@langsync.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Embark idea — LangSync adaptor pilot with Redwood

Thanks all — I pulled together a lightweight security checklist (attached) and flagged a few items that will require customer input:
- Data residency & retention: confirm if Embark needs EU data residency for test users.
- Sample logs: provide a sample redaction/PII policy if any user PII flows.
- Service accounts & keys: recommend ephemeral keys for the pilot environment.

Attached: redwood-security-checklist.xlsx (strawman), example-kms-integration.md

Elena — can you confirm the residency/retention answers and share any mandatory clamp-downs from LangSync side? Jurgen — curious if LangSync needs any SDK-specific headers or token shapes for routing decisions.

Onboarding plan (high level):
- Week 0: SOW & security checks complete
- Week 1: Staging adaptor + smoke tests (small dataset)
- Week 2–3: Load tests & latency tuning; prefix caching enabled
- Week 4: Joint demo & go/no-go

Sooj
From: Elena Torres <elena@embark.ai>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, mateo_alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jurgen Meier <jurgen@langsync.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 16:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Embark idea — LangSync adaptor pilot with Redwood

Hi team — apologies for the slow reply, wanted to confirm with our legal and infra leads.

Answers:
- Data residency: pilot users will all be US-based; no EU residency required for pilot.
- PII: we'll redact direct identifiers from the sample data; policy attached.
- SDK headers: Jurgen confirms LangSync will pass a routing header x-langsync-target: redwood when configured; no other special tokens.

We're happy to proceed on the proposed timeline. I'll attach the sample traffic CSV and a quick note from legal (pilot_limitations.pdf).

Next steps: Mateo — can you share the one-page SOW and a calendar invite for a 30m kickoff on Tue 10/27 10:00am PT? Vanessa — we'll need the pilot credit estimate to finalize approvals.

Thanks — looking forward to working together.
—Elena
